mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_idx AS targetDeptIdx, d.dept_nm AS targetDeptNm, CASE WHEN tvp.can_view = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canView FROM dept_mst d LEFT JOIN team_view_permission tvp ON tvp.target_dept_idx = d.dept_idx AND tvp.viewer_user_idx = #{viewerUserIdx} WHERE COALESCE(d.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(d.upper_dept_idx, 0), d.dept_level NULLS FIRST, d.dept_nm
